subject: Next causal-conv parity must bind actual 8192-channel Qwen topology
body: Lane B inspected the installed Qwen3.5 config/constructor. Actual linear-attention conv topology is key_dim=128*16=2048, value_dim=128*32=4096, conv_dim=key_dim*2+value_dim=8192 channels, kernel width=4, groups=8192, padding=3, bias=False, activation=silu, dtype BF16. The first micro probe tested only 64/128/256 channels and therefore cannot support whole-model/backend promotion even if its thresholds had passed. For the prospective follow-up, bind at least one actual-topology case with channels=8192,width=4,bias=None and predeclare norm-aware/ULP-aware gradient acceptance before seeing results. Keep seq_idx blocked. A smaller matrix can remain for diagnostics, but actual-topology evidence should be mandatory before fla_triton_full training use.
